news.title: ATOME, Rome Resources, Critical Mineral Resources, Bradda Head Lithium, Mila Resources
news.summary: ATOME PLC (AIM:ATOM) has struck a deal to fund a feasibility study for a huge 300 megawatt solar project in Paraguay. The plant would sit right next to its Villeta green fertiliser plant. Rome Resources Plc (AIM:RMR) has found two new mineralised zones at its Kalayi tin deposit in the DRC. They've also spotted an undrilled extension of the high-grade tin trend nearby. Critical Mineral Resources PLC (LSE:CMRS, FRA:98J) is targeting October for its maiden resource estimate at the Agadir Melloul copper project in Morocco. Independent consultants say they're impressed by what they've seen so far. Bradda Head Lithium Ltd (AIM:BHL) has started drilling at its Whistlejacket lithium project in Arizona. Historic holes there all intersected lithium, some at pretty high grades. Mila Resources PLC (LSE:MILA) has identified some compelling copper and gold targets at its Monal project in Queensland.
